pairs: Et locutus est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Loquere ad filios Israël,
“Speak to the sons of Israel,
et accipe ab eis virgas singulas per cognationes suas,
and receive from each of them a rod by their kinships,
a cunctis principibus tribuum,
from all the leaders of the tribes,
virgas duodecim,
twelve rods,
et uniuscujusque nomen superscribes virgæ suæ.
and write the name of each one on his rod.
Nomen autem Aaron erit in tribu Levi,
But the name of Aaron shall be for the tribe of Levi,
et una virga cunctas seorsum familias continebit:
and one rod separately shall contain all their families.
ponesque eas in tabernaculo fœderis coram testimonio,
And you shall place these in the tabernacle of the covenant before the testimony,
ubi loquar ad te.
where I will speak to you.
Quem ex his elegero,
Whomever of these I will choose,
germinabit virga ejus:
his rod will germinate,
et cohibebo a me querimonias filiorum Israël,
and so shall I restrain the complaints of the sons of Israel before me,
quibus contra vos murmurant.
by which they murmur against you.”
Locutusque est Moyses ad filios Israël:
And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel.
et dederunt ei omnes principes virgas per singulas tribus:
And all the leaders gave him rods, one for each tribe.
fueruntque virgæ duodecim absque virga Aaron.
And there were twelve rods, aside from the rod of Aaron.
Quas cum posuisset Moyses coram Domino in tabernaculo testimonii,
And when Moses had placed these before the Lord, in the tabernacle of the testimony,
sequenti die regressus invenit germinasse virgam Aaron in domo Levi:
returning on the following day, he found that the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi, had germinated,
et turgentibus gemmis eruperant flores,
and that the swelling buds had opened into flowers,
qui,
which,
foliis dilatatis,
spreading their petals,
in amygdalas deformati sunt.
were formed into those of an almond tree.
Protulit ergo Moyses omnes virgas de conspectu Domini ad cunctos filios Israël:
Therefore, Moses brought out all the rods, from the sight of the Lord,
videruntque,
to all the sons of Israel.
et receperunt singuli virgas suas.
And they saw, and each one received their rods.
Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen:
And the Lord said to Moses:
Refer virgam Aaron in tabernaculum testimonii,
“Carry back the rod of Aaron into the tabernacle of the testimony,
ut servetur ibi in signum rebellium filiorum Israël,
so that it may be kept there as a sign of the rebellion of the sons of Israel,
et quiescant querelæ eorum a me,
and so that their complaints may be quieted before me,
ne moriantur.
lest they die.”
Fecitque Moyses sicut præceperat Dominus.
And Moses did just as the Lord had instructed.
Dixerunt autem filii Israël ad Moysen:
Then the sons of Israel said to Moses: “Behold,
Ecce consumpti sumus,
we have been consumed;
omnes perivimus.
we have been ruined.
Quicumque accedit ad tabernaculum Domini,
Whoever approaches to the tabernacle of the Lord dies.
moritur.
Will we all be wiped away,
Num usque ad internecionem cuncti delendi sumus?
even to total annihilation?”
